RayMo Tab Screamer

Adding to Chrome

Downloading micro-screamer.zip package…

1
Unzip the downloaded package

Extract micro-screamer.zip into a convenient folder on your drive.

2
Open Chrome Extensions

Copy this address and paste it into your Chrome address bar:

chrome://extensions (Click to copy)
3
Load unpacked extension

Turn on Developer mode (top right toggle) → Click Load unpacked → Select your unzipped folder.
